videos.topic: the last third of the night
videos.title: Every Night, the Last Third
videos.title_en: Who Is Calling Upon Me? The Last Third of the Night
videos.caption: Every night in the last third, Allah asks who is calling upon Him 🌙 Will you wake tonight? Comment In sha Allah 👇

sources.wording: opening per sunnah.com; the three questions per the translation at abuaminaelias.com (Arabic: man yad'uni fa-astajiba lah, man yas'aluni fa-u'tiyah, man yastaghfiruni fa-aghfira lah)

lines.text2: ہر رات، جب دنیا {سو رہی} ہوتی ہے…
lines.say: Every night, | while the world sleeps,
The Prophet, peace be upon him, said:

lines.text: Our Lord descends every night to the lowest heaven, when the {last third} of the night remains, and says:
lines.text2: ہمارا رب ہر رات آسمانِ دنیا پر نزول فرماتا ہے، جب رات کا {آخری تہائی} حصہ باقی رہتا ہے، اور فرماتا ہے:
lines.say: Our Lord descends every night to the lowest heaven, | when the last third of the night remains, and says:

lines.text: “Who is calling upon Me, that I may {answer} him?”
lines.text2: ”کون ہے جو مجھے پکارے کہ میں اس کی {دعا قبول} کروں؟“
lines.say: Who is calling upon Me, | that I may *answer* him?

lines.text: “Who is asking from Me, that I may {give} him?”
lines.text2: ”کون ہے جو مجھ سے مانگے کہ میں اسے {عطا} کروں؟“
lines.say: Who is asking from Me, | that I may *give* him?

lines.text: “Who is seeking My forgiveness, that I may {forgive} him?”
lines.text2: ”کون ہے جو مجھ سے بخشش مانگے کہ میں اسے {بخش} دوں؟“
lines.say: Who is seeking My forgiveness, | that I may *forgive* him?

lines.text: He asks {every night}. Will you be awake to answer?
lines.text2: وہ {ہر رات} پوچھتا ہے۔ کیا آپ جواب دینے کو جاگیں گے؟
lines.say: He asks every night. | Will you be awake to answer?

lines.label: Allah says
lines.text: فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
lines.sub: “…indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.” (Al-Baqarah 2:186)
lines.say: Indeed I am near. | I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.

lines.text: Will you wake tonight? Comment {In sha Allah}.
lines.text2: کیا آج رات اٹھیں گے؟ {ان شاء اللہ} لکھیں۔
lines.say: Will you wake tonight? | Comment, In sha Allah.
